$comment: How the wiki names, colors and orders the game's categories. Pools are keyed by the C# pool class the mod registers content into (SlayTheSpiritsMod.cs); scripts/extract-content.mjs fails the build on a pool missing here. Card colors are the game's CardPoolModel.DeckEntryCardColor, except the Fool, whose DeckEntryCardColor is the Ironclad's red; it uses its frame's yellow (card_frame_yellow). frame, energy and energyOutline are the pool's CardFrameMaterialPath, EnergyColorName and EnergyOutlineColor (default 5C5440). found sentences use the Markdown pages' shorthand: :kw[Shot], :char[Ironclad], [links](play/rest-sites/) and **bold** (refs.inline in src/lib/refs.mjs).

ColorlessCardPool.name: Colorless
ColorlessCardPool.found: Found in colorless card rewards and shops while **Tavern Cards** is on, and offered when you open a tab at a [rest site](play/rest-sites/).

CurseCardPool.name: Curse
CurseCardPool.found: Opening a tab at a [rest site](play/rest-sites/) can add it, and so can anything else that adds a random curse to your deck.

StatusCardPool.name: Status
StatusCardPool.$comment: The drink cards. The drinking game hands them out, and the drink ladder page covers them.

characterFound: Found in the :char[{name}]'s card rewards while **Character Cards** is on, and offered when you open a tab at a [rest site](play/rest-sites/) when playing the {name}.
majorCurseFound: Only from running up a tab at a [rest site](play/rest-sites/). Random curses never include it.

EventRelicPool.name: Tavern
EventRelicPool.found: Only from running up a tab at a [rest site](play/rest-sites/) or the Tavern's Top Shelf, which offer 3 you don't have yet.

SharedPotionPool.name: Any character
SharedPotionPool.found: Found in potion rewards and shops in multiplayer runs, while **Tavern Potions** is on.

$cardStyleComment: How the game draws a card (CardModel, NCard, StsColors). frameType: which frame and portrait border a type uses. rarityStyles: each rarity's banner material (tints the banner, portrait border and type plaque) and title outline color. cardColors: StsColors used on every card.
$keywordsComment: Where the game prints card keywords: CardKeywordOrder. Each 'before' keyword is inserted at the top in this order, so the last one listed ends up first.
